subject: general
question: "Arthashastra" was written by ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chanakya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Arthashastra

 
 
• The Arthashastra is one of the earliest works of political realism to have been written, along with Sun Tzu's The Art of War and Machiavelli's The Prince.
 
• The 'Arthashastra' is a treasure of Political Philosophy. Hence, Option 3 is correct.
 
• It is considered the most comprehensive treatise on statecraft of classical times.
 
• The first-ever book written on Practice of Management, this treatise is also about foreign policy, administration, economic reforms, policies, and war.
 
• It is a primeval Indian discourse on statecraft, economic policy, and military strategy. 
 
• It is written in Sanskrit. 
 
• Kautilya's Arthasashtra was composed between the 3rd to 2nd Century B.C.
 
• It is mainly a work on the art of government.
 
• In his view, for the smooth functioning of administration and the welfare of the people, the king had to be acquainted with the four Vedas and four sciences of government (Anvikashaki, Trai, Varta, and Dandniti). 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• Kautilya's administrative and judicial structure was hierarchical.
 
• He emphasized the principle of equity.
 
• He believed that law was an imperial command enforced by sanctions.
 
• He was both a thinker and statesman.
 
• He contributed to the formulation of some general principles capable of universal application and effectiveness in all times and ages.
 
• Arthsashtra sets the conceptual groundwork for making India the first welfare state.
 
• In Indian theory, State was usually thought to cover seven elements:
 
 
• The king
 
• The ministers
 
• The populace
 
• The fort
 
• The treasury
 
• The army
 
• The ally
